quality_contribution: Next bounded causal-feature and training-weight experiment; no fit is authorized by merely reading this file

hypotheses.personal_context: Past-only email/web/off-hours deviations and short-versus-long personal trends separate unusual behavior from persistently active background accounts
hypotheses.group_weight: Equal fit loss mass for connected-group/class cells reduces domination by long positive episodes
hypotheses.interaction: Personal context and group weighting can improve recall at the same FP1 calibration rule; the factorial ablation separates their contributions

evidence.outer_reuse: All three development outer folds have informed this proposal; even nested re-execution is exploratory, not independent confirmation

population.endpoint_contract: Exclude the first four active account-days per account exactly as in S4; all remaining endpoints and original labels retained

roles.outer_roles: Exact saved S4 outer train/calibration/assessment memberships
roles.inner_rotation_roles: selection=i, calibration=(i+1)%5, fit=remaining three parts, i=0,1,2; outer assessment entirely excluded

models.seed_rationale: S4 HGB controls and selected models had exact identical scores for five seeds per fold. Use one declared seed in this small cycle; seed variation of NEW variants is not estimated or claimed zero. Fold variation remains separate.

feature_contract.history_scope: same account, same role; [date-30,date) and [date-7,date); active days; never current or future day
feature_contract.fallback: If prior30 has fewer than five days, deviation uses frozen unweighted all-fit-active-day global log1p median/IQR (IQR floor 1). Missing short/long trend is zero.
feature_contract.update: emit features before observing current input in every role; labels never clean, skip or reset history
feature_contract.scaling: Fit unweighted mean/std for new columns on permitted fit active days only; std<=1e-12 maps to 1; retain common 75 values/feature order/CSV parsing exactly
feature_contract.dependency_manifest: Store exact ordered prior7/prior30 item lists, fallback state hash, scaler hash and feature formula/version; original 5-day endpoint/window membership unchanged

training_weight.scope: model input endpoints of permitted fit only
training_weight.formula: w_i = N_fit_endpoints / (2 * M_c * n_g_c), c=y_i; M_c is count of fit groups containing class c; n_g_c is fit endpoint count of group g and class c
checks: sum of each class weights equals N_fit_endpoints/2
equal total weight for every present group/class cell within class
IDs/group/labels remain external provenance; numeric feature inputs do not change
calibration/assessment receive no training or metric weights
training_weight.metric_weighting: None: retain original unweighted account-day metrics and supports
training_weight.risk: Rare fit groups gain weight; assess extra FP and scenario regressions without dropping these groups

calibration.scope: permitted calibration endpoints only, after frozen weights
calibration.objective: maximum recall under integer background FP1 budget
calibration.infeasible: retain ineligible status with no fallback profile or additional trial
calibration.legacy_f1_and_fp2: Diagnostic profiles only, following the same saved rules; never selected from outer results

lexicographic_order: more selection parts with FP1 and recall>=0.5 jointly

budget.reuse: Q0 must match immutable saved S4 H0 config/seed/input/state/labels/membership/weights; missing or incompatible exact reuse marks incomplete, never an automatic fresh control fit

required_before_research_execution: Separate user-requested quality increment; S4.7 itself performs no fits
Implement a new versioned plan/worker and immutable runtime/source/role bindings; existing S4 runner must not silently interpret this new schema
Train-only state fit, exact 75-feature preservation, stable endpoints and explicit provenance audit
Freeze full job identities, runtime/config hashes, success gates and total budget before first attempt; open one new ledger
Check actual disk space and SSD bindings; read-only progress view
Run declared matrix once and retain all weak/failed results

next_increments.work: Implement/test personal context and training weights; freeze runtime, data and reuse bindings; no research fits
Execute only the declared 39 slots (at most 30 new fits), save fixed thresholds/inner choices before outer assessment, and report every result

independent_confirmation.rule: Separately accepted compatible behavioral source with entity/duplicate/episode audit, source/schema/label contracts and a frozen model/threshold before opening it
